verdict.rationale: Plausible documents a read-only Stats API whose /api/v2/query endpoint accepts simple and complex stats queries in a POST body and returns metrics as JSON, with team-scoped API keys, so the analytical-query half of the story is covered. Nothing shows raw, event-level records can be pulled back programmatically: the Stats API returns aggregated metrics, and the 'Export stats: download your data' entry is not described as an API. Missing for 10: documented raw event-level export via API, a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI paths return 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of query API usage.
